author: nero_eth
content:
Yes, clients should probably have such additional limits, that go beyond the 10 mib payload size which the CL enforces already.
I'm less sure if this should become part of the specs, as every of those new limits (e.g. nestedness) would need to be a superset of what the protocol allows and we'd never introduce new actual constraints.
If that's the case, I think it's also fine to view it as a client optimization where clients must minimize the time to invalidate a payload and invalidation must never take longer than then worst-case valid payload.

author: nero_eth
content: <@&1460290804898861117> would love clients to double check their early-invalidation logic. For some clients that are fast, slow invalidation might be less of an issue. For others it could be.
